en.text: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

footnotes.text: 111:1 Hebrew: יה Yah. Psalm 111 is an acrostic poem, with each verse after the initial “Praise the LORD!” starting with a letter of the alphabet (ordered from Alef to Tav).
111:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要赞美耶和华！ 我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中， 一心称谢耶和华。

zhTraditional.text: 你們要讚美耶和華！ 我要在正直人的大會中，並公會中， 一心稱謝耶和華。

en.text: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的作为本为大； 凡喜爱的都必考察。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的作為本為大； 凡喜愛的都必考察。

en.text: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

zhSimplified.text: 他所行的是尊荣和威严； 他的公义存到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 他所行的是尊榮和威嚴； 他的公義存到永遠。

en.text: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

zhSimplified.text: 他行了奇事，使人记念； 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。

zhTraditional.text: 他行了奇事，使人記念； 耶和華有恩惠，有憐憫。

en.text: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

zhSimplified.text: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人； 他必永远记念他的约。

zhTraditional.text: 他賜糧食給敬畏他的人； 他必永遠記念他的約。

en.text: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

zhSimplified.text: 他向百姓显出大能的作为， 把外邦的地赐给他们为业。

zhTraditional.text: 他向百姓顯出大能的作為， 把外邦的地賜給他們為業。

en.text: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

zhSimplified.text: 他手所行的是诚实公平； 他的训词都是确实的，

zhTraditional.text: 他手所行的是誠實公平； 他的訓詞都是確實的，

en.text: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

zhSimplified.text: 是永永远远坚定的， 是按诚实正直设立的。

zhTraditional.text: 是永永遠遠堅定的， 是按誠實正直設立的。

en.text: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

zhSimplified.text: 他向百姓施行救赎， 命定他的约，直到永远； 他的名圣而可畏。

zhTraditional.text: 他向百姓施行救贖， 命定他的約，直到永遠； 他的名聖而可畏。

en.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

zhSimplified.text: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端； 凡遵行他命令的是聪明人。 耶和华是永远当赞美的！

zhTraditional.text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端； 凡遵行他命令的是聰明人。 耶和華是永遠當讚美的！
